datasets.name: failures_24h
datasets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clavesa_podbay_traffic_system__pipelines.runs WHERE pipeline = 'podbay-traffic' AND status = 'FAILED' AND started_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 1 DAY

datasets.name: runs_total
datasets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clavesa_podbay_traffic_system__pipelines.runs WHERE pipeline = 'podbay-traffic'

datasets.name: duration
datasets.sql: SELECT x, y FROM (SELECT started_at AS x, duration_ms AS y FROM clavesa_podbay_traffic_system__pipelines.runs WHERE pipeline = 'podbay-traffic' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50) t ORDER BY x ASC

datasets.name: failures_by_node
datasets.sql: SELECT node AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM clavesa_podbay_traffic_system__pipelines.node_runs WHERE pipeline = 'podbay-traffic' AND status = 'failed' GROUP BY node ORDER BY y DESC

datasets.name: recent_runs
datasets.sql: SELECT run_id, status, trigger, duration_ms FROM clavesa_podbay_traffic_system__pipelines.runs WHERE pipeline = 'podbay-traffic' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10
